LAN Audio - Windows sender
  .\start.cmd                  Prepare, pair once, then send audio.
  .\start.cmd --prepare        Download/build only; no pairing or audio.
  .\start.cmd --config FILE    Use a specific declarative launcher file.
Default settings: lan-audio.launch.json beside this launcher.
Start sh start on the Mac first. Keep both windows open. Ctrl+C stops.

LAN Audio - Intel Mac receiver
  sh start                  Prepare, pair once, then receive audio.
  sh start --prepare        Download/build only; no pairing or audio.
  sh start --config FILE    Use a specific declarative launcher file.
Default settings: lan-audio.launch.json beside this launcher.
Start this Mac first, then start.cmd on Windows. Ctrl+C stops.
